findings.title: Adornment as a temporary test surface
findings.claim: The earth's attractive surface is also a temporary testing surface: when its display is cut back to exposed ground, the action elicited through it becomes the durable object of comparison.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries fertile earth, beautification, assigned transformation, and testing; 18:8 repeats the earth-surface frame and supplies cutting, barren ground, and exposed soil. The contact turns adornment into a removable variable whose reversal discloses what the test measured.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why 18:8 changes the force of 18:7: the display is part of the test's setup, while action quality remains legible after the display has gone.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim that earthly adornment is made for testing remains intact. This adds ablation and durability; it does not say that the focus translates as barren ground or that every adornment is unreal.

epistemic.reason: The supplied carrier and trigger make a bounded macro relation visible; source qualifications are preserved in the finding.

findings.title: Adornment as an instrument of action-testing
findings.claim: Earthly adornment functions as an instrument that elicits conduct, so comparison of action quality gives the display a purpose beyond being attractive.
findings.mechanism: Focus beautification, testing, excellence, and intentional action meet 18:2's pairing of صالح deeds with good recompense. That independent work-and-reward frame turns display into a device for bringing conduct into view.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold attraction and evaluation together: the adornment is part of the scene, while the result sought is the quality of what people do within it.
findings.containment: The finding deepens the focus purpose clause and does not assert the physical stripping supplied by 18:8 or reduce action to reward alone.

epistemic.reason: The supplied carrier and trigger make a bounded macro relation visible; source qualifications are preserved in the finding.

findings.claim: The best work also includes honest limits on claimed agency, remembrance after lapse, and willingness to revise toward a nearer right course.
findings.mechanism: The focus action criterion meets 18:23's future-deed claim and 18:24's dependence, forgetting, remembrance, guidance, and nearness. The contact makes correction and recalibration part of action quality.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive excellence as revisable practice: action remains accountable while allowing memory, dependence, and course correction.
findings.containment: The focus still evaluates action in the earthly test. The attributed overlay adds corrigibility to action quality; it does not turn the focus into a standalone rule about future speech.

epistemic.reason: The supplied carrier and trigger make a bounded macro relation visible; source qualifications are preserved in the finding.

findings.title: Adornment as commissioned work
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the adornment can function like a posted commission that calls forth work and reveals whether the worker's performance merits its value.
findings.mechanism: Focus making and action carriers meet payment branches traced in جعل and عمل, while 18:2 supplies the nearby recompense occurrence. The contact turns the test scene into an economic analogy of offered value and evaluated performance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the display as an offered occasion for work, making the comparison concern what the response earns rather than what the display merely promises.
findings.containment: This remains an economic analogy anchored in the focus pair and 18:2. It is not a translation of جعل or عمل as payment, nor a claim that adornment literally constitutes a contract.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks this as an exploratory or lean contextual inference, so the local contact and its limits remain explicit.

findings.title: Memorial layers over disclosed traces
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the test can continue when a community adds visible memorial layers over a disclosed trace, revealing how power converts signs into institutions and adornment.
findings.mechanism: Focus making, adornment, and action carriers meet 18:21's disclosure, construction over the discovered people, prevailing power, and designated worship-place. The contact extends the test from individual conduct to communal framing of what becomes visible.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can notice that visible beauty and purposeful work may also be evaluated by how communities frame discovered traces and whose power fixes that framing.
findings.containment: This is a secondary communal overlay on the focus's ordinary individual-action test. It does not claim that the focus literally means building a memorial or that one institutional response is selected as correct.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks this as an exploratory or lean contextual inference, so the local contact and its limits remain explicit.

findings.title: Earth as a provisioned field
findings.claim: With the individual 1:2 overlay, the focus earth can also be heard as a field held within sustaining care, changing adornment from bare display into provision-capable ground.
findings.mechanism: The focus earth carrier is contacted by 1:2's exact Rabb occurrence and its accompanying worlds expression. The external trigger supplies nurture and domain-scale care, while the focus branch supplies fertile ground.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the earth as a usable, sustained field in addition to an attractive surface.
findings.containment: Only 1:2 is used. This does not import the whole Fatiha, assign every external branch to the focus, or replace adornment and testing.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks this as an exploratory or lean contextual inference, so the local contact and its limits remain explicit.

branch_activations.boundary: The overlay is limited to 1:2 and does not claim a whole-Fatiha provisioning system.

findings.title: The test under a recompense horizon
findings.claim: With the individual 1:4 overlay, the focus comparison of action also opens toward an accountable recompense horizon, so the test is not only an observable distinction within the earthly field.
findings.mechanism: The focus testing and intentional-action carriers meet 1:4's exact day-of-recompense trigger. That contact adds a final accounting horizon while leaving the local purpose and earthly setting intact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold immediate testing and later reckoning together without turning the latter into a replacement translation.
findings.containment: Only the individual 1:4 phrase is used. The finding does not import all Fatiha judgment theology or claim that the focus names a final day.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks this as an exploratory or lean contextual inference, so the local contact and its limits remain explicit.

findings.title: Action as worshipful dependence
findings.claim: With the individual 1:5 overlay, the focus's deliberate action can also be heard as action carried out in worship and reliance on help, adding dependence to the comparison of deeds.
findings.mechanism: The focus action carrier meets the two exact 1:5 acts, worship and seeking assistance. Their contact changes the action criterion by adding the mode in which work is undertaken, not by replacing quality comparison.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive good work as an enacted response that draws on help, rather than self-sufficient performance alone.
findings.containment: Only 1:5 is used. This does not import the complete Fatiha path reading, turn every action into worship, or displace the focus criterion.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks this as an exploratory or lean contextual inference, so the local contact and its limits remain explicit.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus comparison can include action undertaken as worship and with help rather than self-sufficiency.
branch_activations.boundary: The external acts qualify the action reading; they do not become a new gloss for the focus noun.

friction_notes: The automatic host basmala 18:0 was reviewed in Phase 1 and supplied no distinct carrier-trigger delta for 18:7.

The external ayat were quarantined during Phase 1. In Phase 2, 1:2, 1:4, and 1:5 each supplied a bounded local trigger through a focus word; 1:3, 1:6, and 1:7 supplied no additional specific carrier-trigger contact with a changed reading, so no separate external finding was emitted for them.
The focus_word_alignment is fully resolved (13 of 13 analysis units), so no unresolved focus-word join required qualification.

Legacy_unbound HFT records and unresolved context branch records are retained as attributed evidence. Their branch_gloss and facet_statement fields remain null where the packet supplied no lexicon descriptor; no gloss or facet was invented.
